shared_elements: schematic rendering of the human body
justification: Both depict human forms, but A is a single three-dimensional bust-like figure with a modelled head, facial features and torso, while B is a linear scene of two boats with upturned prows crewed by rows of tiny stick-like crew strokes. The only correspondence is the generic presence of anthropomorphic figures; the schematic repeated crew-marks bear no relation to A's individualised sculpted head, and there is no shared arrangement or relationship.
